Flex Physiotherapy is Perth's only hand and upper limb clinic staffed by physiotherapists. Conveniently located in Murdoch, Western Australia, we offer the highest quality of physiotherapy care for people with hand and upper limb injury, pain and dysfunction.

Here you'll find a wide range of physiotherapy related video content including exercises, splint care and more.
